_about: Every search box on the site, and how ci/search_examples.mjs uses it like a reader:
open the page, type each example the box itself shows (the text after 'e.g.' in its
placeholder, or the whole placeholder when it is a plain list), plus the 'extra' queries,
and require at least one hit. 'area' is the element the results are drawn into; 'hits'
counts the results. 'ready' (optional) must match before typing: a page with nothing in
it has no data on this server, and is reported as skipped rather than failed.
ci/guards.py fails when a search box in web/ is missing from this file. A box that cannot
be run here goes under 'elsewhere' or 'not_run' with the reason: gaps stay visible.

elsewhere.write.js#wd-cvq: The coverage search on a publication's Coverage tab, inside the signed-in Writer Desk. tests/test_search_examples.py types the box's own examples and the obvious company queries into the same search.
elsewhere.desk-research.js#class=dk-rs-q: Inside the signed-in research desk, on every Research data tab. Its examples and the obvious queries run against the same search in tests/test_search_examples.py.
elsewhere.desk.js#data-f=q: The search box on a chart in the signed-in desk. An empty chart runs the desk's data search, and tests/test_search_examples.py types the box's own examples into it.
elsewhere.my.html#my-co-q: The Add a company box on the Companies tab of Plover (my.html), behind a sign-in. It searches Japan (app/assistant/api.find_companies, as the Writer Desk's coverage box) and US listed companies (find_us_companies) together; tests/test_search_examples.py types the box's own examples and the obvious company queries into it.

not_run.desk-tabs.js#class=dk-at-q: Filters the writer's own articles, already listed under + Open Article in the desk; there is nothing to fetch.
not_run.sortable.js#class=table-filter: Filters the rows a table already shows; there is nothing to fetch.
not_run.us-companies-admin.js#uca-q: The company search on the signed-in admin Companies tab, United States. It runs the same search as us-company.html#uc-q (/api/v1/us/company?q=), whose examples are typed in a real browser; tests/test_us_company.py checks the admin route.
not_run.us-companies-admin.js#jca-q: The company search on the signed-in admin Companies tab, Japan. It runs the same search as company.html's company box (/api/v1/equity/companies?q=), whose examples are typed in a real browser; tests/test_jp_companies.py checks the admin route.
not_run.admin.js#rh-find: Filters the datasets already listed on the signed-in admin Release History page; there is nothing to fetch.
not_run.assistant.js#cat-q: Filters the specialists already listed; there is nothing to fetch.
not_run.assistant.js#class=st-pick: Studies: picks a series for a ready-made analysis through /api/v1/assistant/studies/series. The Assistant needs a signed-in account, which this check does not have; tests/test_studies.py exercises the endpoint with CPI and 10-year examples.
not_run.us-stocks.js#an-q: The follow-up box under an answer on the home page. It sends its question through the same ask() as index.html#q, whose examples are typed in a real browser by ci/search_examples.py; it only exists once an answer is showing.
not_run.my.html#ov-q: The question box on Your Plover's Overview, for a signed-in reader. It sends its question into a new chat through the same send() as the chat box on the same page (my.html#my-q), so it answers exactly as that box does; the reader check cannot sign in.

not_searches.assistant.js#l-name: A name for a new list.
not_searches.assistant.js#class=st-name: Studies: a short name the query uses for a series (e.g. japan).
not_searches.assistant.js#class=st-ref: Studies: the dataset:code of a series, typed or set by the Analyst; it does not search.
not_searches.assistant.js#st-chcols: Studies: which result columns to chart.
not_searches.cohorts.html#p-company: Highlights one company in a ranking; it does not search.
not_searches.desk-research.js#snap-: A page address to copy a chart from.
not_searches.desk.js#data-f=source: A source line for a table or chart.
not_searches.desk.js#data-f=unit: The unit printed on a chart of the writer's own numbers.
not_searches.memory-panel.js#class=memp-new: The text of a new memory note; it does not search.
